mapper.sql: FROM tb_order o LEFT JOIN tb_channel c ON c.channel_seq = o.channel_seq LEFT JOIN tb_code_group rg ON rg.code_group_id = 'REASON_CANCEL' LEFT JOIN tb_code rc ON rc.code_group_seq = rg.code_group_seq AND rc.code_id = o.cancel_reason

o.order_seq, o.order_no, o.channel_seq, o.ext_order_no, o.order_status, o.ordered_at, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.zip_code, o.address, o.address_detail, o.delivery_memo, o.remark, o.canceled_by, o.canceled_at, o.cancel_reason, o.created_by, o.created_at, o.updated_by, o.updated_at, c.channel_id AS channel_id, c.channel_name AS channel_name, rc.code_name AS cancel_reason_name,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order_line l WHERE l.order_seq = o.order_seq) AS line_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.order_qty), 0) FROM tb_order_line l WHERE l.order_seq = o.order_seq) AS total_qty

where.if: AND ( o.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR o.ext_order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR o.receiver_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR o.remark ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_order_line l WHERE l.order_seq = o.order_seq AND l.sku_seq IS NULL AND l.line_status <> 'CANCELED')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = l.sku_seq WHERE l.order_seq = o.order_seq AND k.sku_id = #{skuId})

mapper.select: SELECT l.line_seq, l.order_seq, l.line_no, l.sku_seq, l.ext_product_code, l.ext_option_code, l.ext_product_name, l.ext_option_name, l.order_qty, l.line_status, l.unit_price, l.line_amount, l.remark, l.created_by, l.created_at, l.updated_by, l.updated_at, o.order_no AS order_no, k.sku_id AS sku_id, k.color_code AS color_code, k.size_code AS size_code, pr.product_id AS product_id, pr.product_name AS product_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty_available), 0) FROM tb_stock s WHERE s.sku_seq = l.sku_seq) AS qty_available, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.qty_allocated - a.qty_released), 0) FROM tb_stock_alloc a WHERE a.order_line_seq = l.line_seq) AS qty_allocated FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_order o ON o.order_seq = l.order_seq LEFT JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = l.sku_seq LEFT JOIN tb_product pr ON pr.product_seq = k.product_seq WHERE l.order_seq = #{orderSeq} ORDER BY l.line_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order ( order_no, channel_seq, ext_order_no, order_status, ordered_at, receiver_name, receiver_phone, zip_code, address, address_detail, delivery_memo, remark, created_by) VALUES ( #{orderNo}, #{channelSeq}, #{extOrderNo}, #{orderStatus}, #{orderedAt}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{deliveryMemo}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})

INSERT INTO tb_order_line ( order_seq, line_no, sku_seq, ext_product_code, ext_option_code, ext_product_name, ext_option_name, order_qty, line_status, unit_price, line_amount, remark, created_by) VALUES ( #{orderSeq}, #{lineNo}, #{skuSeq}, #{extProductCode}, #{extOptionCode}, #{extProductName}, #{extOptionName}, #{orderQty}, #{lineStatus}, #{unitPrice}, #{lineAmount}, #{remark}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_order SET receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, zip_code = #{zipCode}, address = #{address}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, delivery_memo = #{deliveryMemo}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE order_seq = #{orderSeq}
UPDATE tb_order_line SET line_status = #{lineStatus}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE line_seq = #{lineSeq}
UPDATE tb_order_line SET sku_seq = #{skuSeq}, line_status = #{lineStatus}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE line_seq = #{lineSeq}
mapper.sql: m.mapping_status = 'MAPPED' AND m.use_yn = 'Y' AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_order_line x WHERE x.order_seq = l.order_seq AND x.sku_seq = m.sku_seq AND x.line_seq <> l.line_seq) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_order_line y JOIN tb_channel_sku m2 ON m2.channel_seq = o.channel_seq AND m2.ext_product_code = y.ext_product_code AND m2.ext_option_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM y.ext_option_code AND m2.mapping_status = 'MAPPED' AND m2.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE y.order_seq = l.order_seq AND y.sku_seq IS NULL AND y.line_status <> 'CANCELED' AND m2.sku_seq = m.sku_seq AND y.line_no < l.line_no))
mapper.select:
SELECT o.channel_seq, c.channel_id, c.channel_name, l.ext_product_code, l.ext_option_code, MIN(l.ext_product_name) AS ext_product_name, MIN(l.ext_option_name) AS ext_option_name, COUNT(*) AS line_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_seq) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(l.order_qty), 0) AS total_qty, MIN(o.ordered_at) AS oldest_ordered_at, MIN(CASE WHEN m.use_yn = 'N' THEN 'DISABLED' ELSE m.mapping_status END) AS mapping_status, MIN(k.sku_id) AS mapped_sku_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ) AS conflict_count FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_order o ON o.order_seq = l.order_seq LEFT JOIN tb_channel c ON c.channel_seq = o.channel_seq LEFT JOIN tb_channel_sku m ON m.channel_seq = o.channel_seq AND m.ext_product_code = l.ext_product_code AND m.ext_option_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM l.ext_option_code LEFT JOIN tb_sku k ON k.sku_seq = m.sku_seq
GROUP BY o.channel_seq, c.channel_id, c.channel_name, l.ext_product_code, l.ext_option_code ORDER BY MIN(o.ordered_at)

SELECT l.line_seq, l.order_seq, l.line_no, l.sku_seq, l.ext_product_code, l.ext_option_code, l.ext_product_name, l.ext_option_name, l.order_qty, l.line_status, l.unit_price, l.line_amount, l.remark, l.created_by, l.created_at, l.updated_by, l.updated_at, o.order_no AS order_no FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_order o ON o.order_seq = l.order_seq LEFT JOIN tb_channel c ON c.channel_seq = o.channel_seq
ORDER BY o.ordered_at, l.line_no LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_order_line l JOIN tb_order o ON o.order_seq = l.order_seq LEFT JOIN tb_channel c ON c.channel_seq = o.channel_seq
